description: Deletes annotations by selecting each (IAnnotation.Select3, its sheet shown) and deleting the selection (IModelDoc2.EditDelete), a view or sheet at a time. Deleting an imported model dimension removes it from the drawing only: the model keeps it, with its value (checked). Checked: each is gone, every other annotation is still there, and the model is unchanged. Not rolled back (a deleted annotation cannot be made again as it was): a failed check says what is left, and when SOLIDWORKS refuses one view's annotations after deleting another's, operation_failed gives what is left with rollback_failed. A reference to a deleted annotation no longer resolves. Waits, changing nothing (busy, user_editing), while the user edits a view's sketch or the sheet format (sheet_format: true) or has a command open. After the user exits a view's sketch, SOLIDWORKS keeps that view activated and changes keep waiting until the user lets go of it: ask them to double-click the sheet outside every view.

document.description: The drawing: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

annotations.description: The annotations to delete: each a reference (r1.annotation.…) or a name (with @view when names repeat).
